item.tib: gsas mkhar rab 'byams bka' yi pho nya dbal mo srid pa spyi 'dul gyi 'phrin las
item.coloph: bdag 'dra snyig ma'i sngags 'chang dbal 'bar stag slag can la/ gter bdag ye shes dbal mos lung bstan/ chu byi lo hor zla lnga pa'i tshes nyer gsum gyi srod 'khor la lho rgyal mo tsha ba rong ngo mtshar bkod pa'i zhing khams/ gnas mchog bkra shis spungs pa'i ri bo nas gter la spyan drangs te/ slad mar shing pho stag gi lo la hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes la mdangs ldan g.yung drung gling du shog ser bod yig tu bsgyur ba dge'o//
